summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its Share Purchase Agreement with Shrvan Kumar Yadav, restructuring the acquisition of Anira Consulting FZC into a purchase of specified assets—the TradeOS platform, IP, and Tradewell/TradeOS marks—rather than equity, effective as of June 2, 2026. The purchase price was reduced from $12.0 million to $11.5 million, with the promissory note cut by $500,000 to $4.5 million, while 135,000 common shares and Series B Preferred stock issued remain. The seller retains ownership of Anira; no liabilities were assumed. Watch for integration of the acquired technology and potential disputes over asset scope.
